testcase.name: Scenario: Reveal an off-screen tab when selecting its document: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:308:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reveal an off-screen tab when selecting its document ✔ Given the user opens `Window01.opd` through `Window12.opd` from `fixtures/cad/document-tabs-native/overflow` in order ✔ And the tab strip overflows its available width ✔ And the tab for `fixtures/cad/document-tabs-native/overflow/Window01.opd` is outside the visible portion of the strip ✔ When the user selects that part from the View tab's Switch menu ✔ Then the part becomes active ✔ And the tab strip shifts to show its active tab ✔ And the part's viewport and model browser are displayed
